name: Mailwing
summary: A magic-link waiting screen: a paper plane delivers the email, then carries the link back to sign you in
about: A sign-in card with an airmail border, where a paper plane flies the magic link from the laptop to a mailbox whose flag springs up. Open the demo email and press its button, and the plane flies back so the laptop signs you in with confetti. It also has a 6-character backup code, a waiting timer, a resend countdown and a way to change the email address.
how: Watch the plane deliver the link to the mailbox, then press Open the email
Press Sign in as Hira in the email and the plane carries the link back to the laptop
Or type or paste the 6-character code from the email; backspace and the arrow keys move between boxes
When the 30-second ring runs out, Resend link sends a new link and the old code stops working
Press Change to send the link to another email address
